name: aidrian-mod
description: Optional Claude Code mod for the aidrian plugin: a band above the prompt, an aidrian-mod pane, and notifications. Requires the aidrian plugin.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow logs what would be sent, live sends it

notifyMinTurnSeconds.title: Minimum turn length to notify (seconds)
notifyMinTurnSeconds.description: Turns shorter than this end without a Done notification

focusCheck.title: Skip desktop notifications while the terminal app is in front

focusApp.title: Terminal app for the focus check
focusApp.description: The name macOS gives the terminal app's process, compared with the app in front

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: Play the cute-minimal sounds in live mode

ticketPrefixes.title: Ticket key prefixes
ticketPrefixes.description: Pipe-separated issue key prefixes found in the branch name, at most 32; empty reads a GitHub #N

cacheTtlSeconds.title: Prompt cache lifetime (seconds)
cacheTtlSeconds.description: Used for the cache countdown until the first turn shows the real one
